current_p1_ru: Плёночная эстетика, закаты, природа и детали, минимал. Ты делаешь сторис как маленькие фильмы. Цвет, свет, композиция — каждый кадр продуман.
current_p1_en:
Film aesthetics, sunsets, nature and details, minimal. You make stories like little films. Color, light, composition — every frame is thought through.
This works because you have visual taste. "Selfie in the mirror" bores you; you need aesthetics.
People sometimes admire it: "do you have design education?" No. Just an eye.
What's worth knowing: aesthetic stories take time. If you spend an hour on one story, that's already work, not communication. Balance it. Sometimes a raw frame is stronger than a perfect one.

current_p1_ru: События и тусовки, опросы и вопросы, селфи, мемы и репосты. Ты используешь сторис как инструмент общения. Активные опросы, реакции, вовлечение аудитории.
current_p1_en:
Events and parties, polls and questions, selfies, memes and reposts. You use stories as a communication tool: polls, reactions, audience engagement.
This works because you have a social nature. Stories for you aren't post-and-forget; they're a conversation.
People love this in you. Your polls are an event, and many participate.
What's worth knowing: social stories require follow-through. If you post a poll and don't respond to answers, the audience disperses. Learn to reply. Conversation is a two-way process.

current_p1_ru: Путешествия, рабочий процесс, еда, события. Ты документируешь то, что происходит. Не «постановка»; а реальные моменты, которые потом приятно пересмотреть.
current_p1_en:
Travel, work process, food, events. You document what's happening. Not "staging"; but real moments that are pleasant to revisit later.
This works because you have a relationship with memory. Stories for you are also an archive, not just publication.
People sometimes are surprised: "you film everything?" Everything. In ten years, you'll watch and remember.
What's worth knowing: documenting everything can keep you from living it. If you're always behind a lens, you're not in the moment. Turn off the camera sometimes. The strongest memories are often the ones you didn't manage to film.

current_p1_ru: Плёночная эстетика, рабочий процесс, трек дня, только текст. Ты выкладываешь свою творческую жизнь. Не «отчёт»; а кусочки процесса, в котором другие могут вдохновиться.
current_p1_en:
Film aesthetics, work process, track of the day, only text. You post your creative life. Not "a report"; but pieces of the process in which others can be inspired.
This works because you have a creative practice. And you understand that showing the process matters more than showing only the result.
People sometimes say: "you post the unfinished". Yes. That's what's interesting: seeing something being born.
What's worth knowing: creative stories attract creative people. Learn to use this for networking. Your audience is potential collaborators, not just viewers.

current_p1_ru: Природа и детали, закаты, путешествия, плёночная эстетика. Тебя цепляет естественное. Закат, лужи, листья, свет в окне — то, что большинство пропускают.
current_p1_en:
Nature and details, sunsets, travel, film aesthetics. The natural world gets you. Sunsets, puddles, leaves, light in the window — the things most people miss.
This works because you notice. The big picture isn't enough for you; you need the details.
People sometimes don't understand: "why a story with a puddle?" Because the sky reflects beautifully in that puddle.
What's worth knowing: natural stories require time and a good eye. If you only post "I'm here" without attention to detail, that's not a natural style. Look at your photos as a viewer: is there something there that would catch someone else?

current_p1_ru: Винил, CD-бокс, digipak, концертный постер. Твой мир — это музыка как объект. Не просто стримы — а предметы, которые можно взять в руки, пересмотреть обложку, прочитать буклет.
current_p1_en:
Vinyl, CD box, digipak, concert poster. Your world is music as an object. Not just streams, but things you can hold, study the cover of, and read the booklet from.
This works because you have a tactile connection with art. Digital feels too ephemeral to you; you need something physical that won't disappear when the service shuts down.
People sometimes don't understand: "why vinyl, you have Spotify?" Because vinyl is a different relationship. It's a ritual, not background.
What's worth knowing: collecting is both hobby and risk. If you have 200 records and no time to listen to them, that's no longer a collection — it's a warehouse. Listen to what you buy. Otherwise love for music becomes love for buying music, and those are different feelings.

current_p1_ru: Кинопостер, журнальная обложка, DVD-обложка, steelbook. Тебе нужна большая визуальная подача, как у настоящего блокбастера или модного журнала. Жизнь должна быть кинематографичной.
current_p1_en:
Film poster, magazine cover, DVD cover, steelbook. You need big visual presentation, like a real blockbuster or a fashion magazine. Life should feel cinematic.
This works because you have cinematic perception. Most people see life as a stream of routine; you see a plot with acts, climaxes, and frames.
People sometimes call you "dramatic". Not dramatic — attentive. You just notice ordinary moments that deserve a frame.
What's worth knowing: a cinematic gaze is wonderful, but it can create distance. If you constantly film your life, you don't live it — you film it. Turn the camera off sometimes and just be. The strongest cinema is often the one you didn't manage to capture.

current_p1_ru: Классическая книга в твёрдом переплёте, мягкая обложка, артбук. Тебе нужна страница, шрифт, текстура переплёта. Электронная книга для тебя — это решение проблемы, а не сама книга.
current_p1_en:
Classic hardcover, paperback, art book. You need the page, the font, the texture of the binding. An e-book is a solution to a problem, not the book itself.
This works because you read not only the text, but the form. The cover, paper, and size are part of the work for you; without them, something is lost.
People sometimes don't understand: "does everything have to be on paper for you?" Not everything, but the important ones. If a book matters, it belongs on paper.
What's worth knowing: paper books are more expensive and heavier. If space or budget is limited, you have to choose. Learn which books need to be paper for you and which can stay digital. Not every book deserves a shelf, and that's normal.

current_p1_ru: Комикс, коробка игры, артбук. Твоё мироощущение — на стыке кино, литературы и интерактивности. Графический роман с супергероем, артбук концепт-арта, коробка PC-игры с дискетой и мануалом.
current_p1_en:
Comic, game box, art book. Your visual world sits at the junction of cinema, literature, and interactivity. A graphic novel with a superhero, an art book of concept art, a PC game box with a floppy and a manual.
This works because you grew up on these forms. They're native to you, not niche. And the world for you is structured through their aesthetics.
People sometimes are surprised: "you're still a comics fan?". Still. And what's wrong with that?
What's worth knowing: this aesthetic is great, but it can narrow you. If you only live in graphic narratives, you miss literature without illustrations and cinema without capes. Step outside the zone sometimes. Not to reject the favorite, but to expand taste.

current_p1_ru: Открытка, настенный календарь, винил, CD. Твой мир пропитан тёплой памятью. Бабушкина открытка из Крыма, советский календарь с котом, плёночная пластинка от родителей.
current_p1_en:
Postcard, wall calendar, vinyl, CD. Your world is soaked in warm memory: a grandmother's postcard from Crimea, a Soviet calendar with a cat, a record from your parents.
This works because you understand: the value of things is often not in their price, but in their history. And you collect objects with a past — even if only a short one.
People sometimes don't share it: "why do you need an old calendar?" Because it has a life, unlike many modern things.
What's worth knowing: nostalgia is powerful, but it can become escapism. If your room holds only the past, there's no place for the present. Balance it: a few warm things from before + life today. Then nostalgia is a core, not a cage.

current_p1_ru: Steelbook, digipak, винил, концертный постер. Тебе важно не просто иметь — а иметь редкое, лимитированное, специальное издание. Ты не просто покупаешь; ты охотишься.
current_p1_en:
Steelbook, digipak, vinyl, concert poster. It matters to you not just to own something, but to own rare, limited, special editions. You don't just buy; you hunt.
This works because you chase the thrill. Getting what not everyone has isn't bragging; it's sporting satisfaction. That's where the high is.
People sometimes don't understand: "why a steelbook if there's an ordinary disc?". Because a steelbook isn't just a medium; it's an object. That's the difference.
What's worth knowing: collecting is a great hobby but dangerous for the budget. If you spend on limited editions more than you can afford — that's no longer love, it's compulsion. Learn to separate. And remember — a rare object is valuable not in itself, but in what you do with it.

current_p1_ru: Мягкая обложка книги, открытка, настенный календарь, коробка пазла. Ты не охотник за редкостями, не коллекционер дорогого. Тебе хорошо с предметами, которые повседневны и доступны, но имеют душу.
current_p1_en:
Paperback, postcard, wall calendar, puzzle box. You're not a hunter of rarities, not a collector of expensive things. You're drawn to everyday, accessible objects with soul.
This works because you have the ability to value the simple. Most people need "the special" to be content; for you a warm format of a book in your pocket is enough.
People sometimes don't share it: "are all your shelves paperbacks?". Yes. And they're dear to me.
What's worth knowing: love for the simple is wonderful, but it can become a refusal of quality. If you always choose the cheap option because "why pay for an edition", you miss the beautiful, higher-quality alternatives. Make exceptions sometimes. A good edition of a favorite book isn't bragging; it's preservation.
